permittedChanges: Source retrieval, denomination/concept normalization, exact PIT acceptance/cutoff guards, original-accession and fiscal-context evidence, issuer/listing/share-class identity validation and explicit missing/conflict/certification statuses.

Canonical observed data contract, split/share-price basis reconciliation, complete action prefix and dated security-master audit with expanded coverage/reason counts; no changed common price/liquidity thresholds.

Execution rejection metadata, certified next-session open availability and method fill-validator enforcement without changing fill timing, stop logic, target weights, risk fractions, costs or partial-exit policy.

Explicitly versioned isolated correctness bug fix with synthetic source-semantic tests, unchanged original source rules/parameters and separate implementation hash; never silently overwrite original frozen code.
Certification/admissibility enums alongside unchanged fixed performance scorecard; preserve separate performance/data/fidelity/execution dimensions and reasons.
Factor final ex-post data can be separately labeled PARTIAL_RESEARCH_DATA with PIT_NOT_CERTIFIED; no claim the realized revision vintage was known at historic formation.
forbiddenChanges: No alteration to original thresholds, selection fractions, ranking directions, tie/quantile conventions, holding durations, schedules, cohort accounting, weights, stops, ATR/N lookbacks, sell fractions, partial timing, cap rules, cash yield, costs, leverage/shorting, benchmark, regimes, signal windows/HAC/minimums, score weights, tier gates or distinctiveness values.

No replacing missing source concepts with convenient economic proxies: WAVG EPS shares, currentlatest/restated latest, issuer aggregate shares times single-class price, ADR guesses, PE/EPS/book substitutes, EBIT silently equal to unrelated operating income, total debt copied from only one maturity, SIC from current sector labels or factor/industry ETF proxies.
No amendment/restatement or later comparative backdated to earlier report acceptance; no FY based solely on comparative companyfacts filing fy/fp.

No price carry-forward fabricated next-open fill, intraday stop substitution, retry at a different advantageous session, future execution-day low, known terminal proceeds invented, or reinterpretation of DATA_QUARANTINE as official delisting.
No automatic HIGH PIT confidence from canonical observed prefixes, truthy sec/delist objects, current metadata or scheduled-loader counts.
No frozen-source files/Core481 migration, branch merge/live change/new paid provider, old performance-driven mappings or invented residual-momentum holding variant.
